verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֔ב ק֛וּם עֲלֵ֥ה בֵֽית־ אֵ֖ל וְשֶׁב־ שָׁ֑ם וַעֲשֵׂה־ שָׁ֣ם מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לָאֵל֙ הַנִּרְאֶ֣ה אֵלֶ֔יךָ בְּבָרְחֲךָ֔ מִפְּנֵ֖י עֵשָׂ֥ו אָחִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- ya·‘ă·qōḇ qūm ‘ă·lêh ḇêṯ- ’êl wə·šeḇ- šām wa·‘ă·śêh- šām miz·bê·aḥ lā·’êl han·nir·’eh ’ê·le·ḵā bə·ḇå̄·rə·ḥă·ḵå̄ mip·pə·nê ‘ê·śāw ’ā·ḥî·ḵā
verses.literal: Then God said to Jacob Arise go up to Bethel and settle there Build an altar there to the God who appeared to you when you fled from your brother Esau
verses.literalPt: Disse Deus a Jacó: Levanta-te, sobe a Betel e habita ali; faze ali um altar ao Deus que te apareceu quando fugiste da face de Esaú, teu irmão.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל־ בֵּית֔וֹ וְאֶ֖ל כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֑וֹ הָסִ֜רוּ אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַנֵּכָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּתֹכְכֶ֔ם וְהִֽטַּהֲר֔וּ וְהַחֲלִ֖יפוּ שִׂמְלֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’el- bê·ṯōw wə·’el kāl- ’ă·šer ‘im·mōw hā·si·rū ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê han·nê·ḵār ’ă·šer bə·ṯō·ḵə·ḵem wə·hiṭ·ṭa·hă·rū wə·ha·ḥă·lî·p̄ū śim·lō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: So Jacob told . . . his household . . . and all who were with him Get rid of the foreign gods that are among you Purify yourselves and change your garments
verses.literalPt: Então, disse Jacó à sua família e a todos os que estavam com ele: Lançai fora os deuses estrangeiros que estão no meio de vós, purificai-vos e mudai os vossos vestidos;

verses.original: וְנָק֥וּמָה וְנַעֲלֶ֖ה בֵּֽית־ אֵ֑ל וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ שָּׁ֣ם מִזְבֵּ֗חַ לָאֵ֞ל הָעֹנֶ֤ה אֹתִי֙ בְּי֣וֹם צָֽרָתִ֔י וַיְהִי֙ עִמָּדִ֔י בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽכְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·qū·māh wə·na·‘ă·leh bêṯ- ’êl wə·’e·‘ĕ·śeh- šām miz·bê·aḥ lā·’êl hā·‘ō·neh ’ō·ṯî bə·yō·wm ṣā·rā·ṯî way·hî ‘im·mā·ḏî bad·de·reḵ ’ă·šer hā·lā·ḵə·tî
verses.literal: Then let us arise and go to Bethel I will build an altar there to God who answered me in my day of distress He has been with me wherever I have gone
verses.literalPt: levantemo-nos e subamos a Betel. Ali, farei um altar ao Deus que me respondeu no dia da minha angústia e esteve comigo no caminho em que andei.

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֗ב אֵ֣ת כָּל־ אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַנֵּכָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיָדָ֔ם וְאֶת־ הַנְּזָמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּאָזְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּטְמֹ֤ן אֹתָם֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב תַּ֥חַת הָאֵלָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם־ שְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nū ’el- ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’êṯ kāl- ’ĕ·lō·hê han·nê·ḵār ’ă·šer bə·yā·ḏām wə·’eṯ- han·nə·zā·mîm ’ă·šer bə·’ā·zə·nê·hem way·yiṭ·mōn ’ō·ṯām ya·‘ă·qōḇ ta·ḥaṯ hā·’ê·lāh ’ă·šer ‘im- šə·ḵem
verses.literal: So they gave . . . Jacob all their . . . foreign gods and all their earrings - and Jacob buried them under the oak near Shechem
verses.literalPt: Deram, pois, a Jacó todos os deuses estrangeiros que possuíam e as arrecadas que pendiam das suas orelhas; Jacó escondeu-os debaixo do terebinto que está junto a Siquém.

verses.original: וַיִּסָּ֑עוּ וַיְהִ֣י׀ חִתַּ֣ת אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַל־ הֶֽעָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ סְבִיבֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֣א רָֽדְפ֔וּ אַחֲרֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·sā·‘ū way·hî ḥit·taṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘al- he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯê·hem wə·lō rā·ḏə·p̄ū ’a·ḥă·rê bə·nê ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: As they set out a terror from God fell over the surrounding cities so that they did not pursue . . . Jacob’s sons
verses.literalPt: Então, partiram; veio o terror de Deus sobre as cidades que lhes eram circunvizinhas, e não perseguiram os filhos de Jacó.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א יַעֲקֹ֜ב ל֗וּזָה אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן הִ֖וא בֵּֽית־ אֵ֑ל ה֖וּא וְכָל־ הָעָ֥ם אֲשֶׁר־ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ya·‘ă·qōḇ lū·zāh ’ă·šer bə·’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an hî bêṯ- ’êl hū wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ’ă·šer- ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: So Jacob and everyone . . . with him arrived in Luz (that is . . . Bethel) . . . in the land of Canaan
verses.literalPt: Assim, chegou Jacó a Luz, que está na terra de Canaã (esta é Betel), ele e todo o povo que estava com ele.

verses.original: וַיִּ֤בֶן שָׁם֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ וַיִּקְרָא֙ לַמָּק֔וֹם אֵ֖ל בֵּֽית־ אֵ֑ל כִּ֣י שָׁ֗ם נִגְל֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים בְּבָרְח֖וֹ מִפְּנֵ֥י אָחִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen šām miz·bê·aḥ way·yiq·rā lam·mā·qō·wm ’êl bêṯ- ’êl kî šām niḡ·lū ’ê·lāw hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·ḇā·rə·ḥōw mip·pə·nê ’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: There Jacob built an altar and he called that place El-bethel because it was there that God had revealed Himself to Jacob as he fled from his brother
verses.literalPt: Edificou ali um altar e chamou ao lugar El-Betel; porque ali Deus se lhe revelou, quando fugiu da face de seu irmão.

verses.original: וַתָּ֤מָת דְּבֹרָה֙ מֵינֶ֣קֶת רִבְקָ֔ה וַתִּקָּבֵ֛ר מִתַּ֥חַת לְבֵֽית־ אֵ֖ל תַּ֣חַת הָֽאַלּ֑וֹן וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ אַלּ֥וֹן בָּכֽוּת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·māṯ də·ḇō·rāh mê·ne·qeṯ riḇ·qāh wat·tiq·qā·ḇêr mit·ta·ḥaṯ lə·ḇêṯ- ’êl ta·ḥaṯ hā·’al·lō·wn way·yiq·rā šə·mōw ’al·lō·wn bā·ḵūṯ
verses.literal: Now Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died and was buried under the oak below Bethel So Jacob named it Allon-bacuth
verses.literalPt: Morreu Débora, ama de Rebeca, e foi sepultada ao pé de Betel, debaixo do carvalho que se chamava Alom-Bacute.

verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹב֙ ע֔וֹד בְּבֹא֖וֹ מִפַּדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֑ם וַיְבָ֖רֶךְ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rā ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- ya·‘ă·qōḇ ‘ō·wḏ bə·ḇō·’ōw mip·pad·dan ’ă·rām way·ḇā·reḵ ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: After Jacob had returned from Paddan-aram God appeared to him again and blessed him
verses.literalPt: Apareceu Deus a Jacó outra vez, quando voltou de Padã-Arã e o abençoou.

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמֶר־ ל֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים שִׁמְךָ֣ יַעֲקֹ֑ב לֹֽא־ יִקָּרֵא֩ שִׁמְךָ֙ ע֜וֹד יַעֲקֹ֗ב כִּ֤י אִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שְׁמֶ֔ךָ וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer- lōw ’ĕ·lō·hîm šim·ḵā ya·‘ă·qōḇ lō- yiq·qā·rê šim·ḵå̄ ‘ō·wḏ ya·‘ă·qōḇ kî ’im- yiś·rā·’êl yih·yeh šə·me·ḵā way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And God said to him Though your name is Jacob you will no longer be called . . . Jacob Instead . . . your name will be Israel So God named him Israel
verses.literalPt: Disse- lhe Deus: O teu nome é Jacó. Não te chamarás mais Jacó, porém o teu nome será Israel. E chamou-lhe Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ ל֨וֹ אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֲנִ֨י אֵ֤ל שַׁדַּי֙ פְּרֵ֣ה וּרְבֵ֔ה גּ֛וֹי וּקְהַ֥ל גּוֹיִ֖ם יִהְיֶ֣ה מִמֶּ֑ךָּ וּמְלָכִ֖ים מֵחֲלָצֶ֥יךָ יֵצֵֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·nî ’êl šad·day pə·rêh ū·rə·ḇêh gō·w ū·qə·hal gō·w·yim yih·yeh mim·me·kā ū·mə·lā·ḵîm mê·ḥă·lā·ṣe·ḵā yê·ṣê·’ū
verses.literal: And God told him I am God Almighty Be fruitful and multiply A nation even a company of nations shall come from you and kings shall descend from you
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe mais: Eu sou o Deus Todo-Poderoso; frutifica e multiplica-te. Uma nação e uma multidão de nações sairão de ti, e reis procederão dos teus lombos.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛תִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם וּלְיִצְחָ֖ק לְךָ֣ אֶתְּנֶ֑נָּה וּֽלְזַרְעֲךָ֥ אַחֲרֶ֖יךָ אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lə·’aḇ·rā·hām ū·lə·yiṣ·ḥāq lə·ḵā ’et·tə·nen·nāh ū·lə·zar·‘ă·ḵā ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā ’et·tên ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The land that I gave to Abraham and Isaac I will give to you and I will give this land to your descendants after you
verses.literalPt: A terra que dei a Abraão e a Isaque, a ti a darei; também à tua descendência, depois de ti, darei a terra.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַל מֵעָלָ֖יו אֱלֹהִ֑ים בַּמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al mê·‘ā·lāw ’ĕ·lō·hîm bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- dib·ber ’it·tōw
verses.literal: Then God went up from the place where He had spoken with him
verses.literalPt: Deus retirou-se dele no lugar onde lhe falou.

verses.original: וַיַּצֵּ֨ב יַעֲקֹ֜ב מַצֵּבָ֗ה בַּמָּק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ מַצֶּ֣בֶת אָ֑בֶן וַיַּסֵּ֤ךְ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ נֶ֔סֶךְ וַיִּצֹ֥ק עָלֶ֖יהָ שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ya·‘ă·qōḇ maṣ·ṣê·ḇāh bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- dib·ber ’it·tōw maṣ·ṣe·ḇeṯ ’ā·ḇen way·yas·sêḵ ‘ā·le·hā ne·seḵ way·yi·ṣōq ‘ā·le·hā šā·men
verses.literal: So Jacob set up a pillar in the place where God had spoken with him a stone marker and he poured out a drink offering on it and anointed it . . . with oil
verses.literalPt: Jacó erigiu uma coluna, uma coluna de pedra, no lugar onde Deus lhe falara; sobre ela derramou uma libação e deitou-lhe azeite.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶת־ שֵׁ֣ם הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבֶּ֨ר אִתּ֥וֹ שָׁ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בֵּֽית־ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’eṯ- šêm ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer dib·ber ’it·tōw šām ’ĕ·lō·hîm bêṯ- ’êl
verses.literal: Jacob called . . . the place where God had spoken with him Bethel
verses.literalPt: Jacó chamou Betel ao lugar onde Deus lhe falara.

verses.original: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית אֵ֔ל וַֽיְהִי־ ע֥וֹד כִּבְרַת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ לָב֣וֹא אֶפְרָ֑תָה וַתֵּ֥לֶד רָחֵ֖ל וַתְּקַ֥שׁ בְּלִדְתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mib·bêṯ ’êl way·hî- ‘ō·wḏ kiḇ·raṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ lā·ḇō·w ’ep̄·rā·ṯāh wat·tê·leḏ rā·ḥêl wat·tə·qaš bə·liḏ·tāh
verses.literal: Later, they set out from Bethel and while they were still some distance . . . . . . from Ephrath Rachel began to give birth and her labor was difficult
verses.literalPt: Partiram de Betel, e ainda havia um trecho antes de chegar a Efrata. Raquel estava de parto, e custou-lhe o dar à luz.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י בְהַקְשֹׁתָ֖הּ בְּלִדְתָּ֑הּ וַתֹּ֨אמֶר לָ֤הּ הַמְיַלֶּ֙דֶת֙ אַל־ תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י כִּֽי־ גַם־ זֶ֥ה לָ֖ךְ בֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇə·haq·šō·ṯāh bə·liḏ·tāh wat·tō·mer lāh ham·yal·le·ḏeṯ ’al- tî·rə·’î kî- ḡam- zeh lāḵ bên
verses.literal: During her severe labor the midwife said to her Do not be afraid for you are having another son
verses.literalPt: Quando ela estava nas dores do parto, disse-lhe a parteira: Não temas; pois ainda terás este filho.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י בְּצֵ֤את נַפְשָׁהּ֙ כִּ֣י מֵ֔תָה וַתִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ בֶּן־ אוֹנִ֑י וְאָבִ֖יו קָֽרָא־ ל֥וֹ בִנְיָמִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·ṣêṯ nap̄·šāh kî mê·ṯāh wat·tiq·rā šə·mōw ben- ’ō·w·nî wə·’ā·ḇîw qā·rā- lōw ḇin·yā·mîn
verses.literal: And with her last breath for she was dying she named . . . him Ben-oni But his father called him Benjamin
verses.literalPt: Ao sair-lhe a alma (porque morreu), chamou-lhe Benoni; mas seu pai chamou-lhe Benjamim.

verses.original: וַתָּ֖מָת רָחֵ֑ל וַתִּקָּבֵר֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אֶפְרָ֔תָה הִ֖וא בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·māṯ rā·ḥêl wat·tiq·qā·ḇêr bə·ḏe·reḵ ’ep̄·rā·ṯāh hî bêṯ lā·ḥem
verses.literal: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is . . . Bethlehem)
verses.literalPt: Morreu Raquel e foi sepultada no caminho que vai a Efrata (esta é Belém).

verses.original: וַיַּצֵּ֧ב יַעֲקֹ֛ב מַצֵּבָ֖ה עַל־ קְבֻרָתָ֑הּ הִ֛וא מַצֶּ֥בֶת קְבֻֽרַת־ רָחֵ֖ל עַד־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ya·‘ă·qōḇ maṣ·ṣê·ḇāh ‘al- qə·ḇu·rā·ṯāh hî maṣ·ṣe·ḇeṯ qə·ḇu·raṯ- rā·ḥêl ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave it marks Rachel’s tomb to this day
verses.literalPt: Jacó erigiu sobre a sepultura de Raquel uma coluna, que existe até o dia de hoje.

verses.original: וַיִּסַּ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּ֣ט אָֽהֳלֹ֔ה מֵהָ֖לְאָה לְמִגְדַּל־ עֵֽדֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·sa‘ yiś·rā·’êl way·yêṭ ʾå̄·ho·lōh mê·hā·lə·’āh lə·miḡ·dal- ‘ê·ḏer
verses.literal: Israel again set out and pitched his tent beyond the Tower of Eder
verses.literalPt: Partiu Israel e armou a sua tenda além da torre de Éder.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּשְׁכֹּ֤ן יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֔וא וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ רְאוּבֵ֔ן וַיִּשְׁכַּ֕ב֙ אֶת־ בִּלְהָ֖ה֙ פִּילֶ֣גֶשׁ אָבִ֑֔יו וַיִּשְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵֽ֑ל פ וַיִּֽהְי֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî biš·kōn yiś·rā·’êl bā·’ā·reṣ ha·hi·w way·yê·leḵ rə·’ū·ḇên way·yiš·kaḇ ’eṯ- bil·hāh pî·le·ḡeš ’ā·ḇîw way·yiš·ma‘ yiś·rå̄·ʾēl p̄ way·yih·yū ḇə·nê- ya·‘ă·qōḇ šə·nêm ‘ā·śār
verses.literal: While Israel was living in that region Reuben went in and slept with his father’s concubine Bilhah and Israel . . . heard about it Jacob had twelve . . . sons
verses.literalPt: Habitando Israel naquela terra, foi Rúben e deitou-se com Bila, concubina de seu pai; e Israel o soube. Os filhos de Jacó eram doze:

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י לֵאָ֔ה בְּכ֥וֹר יַעֲקֹ֖ב רְאוּבֵ֑ן וְשִׁמְעוֹן֙ וְלֵוִ֣י וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְיִשָּׂשכָ֖ר וּזְבוּלֻֽן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê lê·’āh bə·ḵō·wr ya·‘ă·qōḇ rə·’ū·ḇên wə·šim·‘ō·wn wə·lê·wî wî·hū·ḏāh wə·yiś·śā·š·ḵār ū·zə·ḇū·lun
verses.literal: The sons of Leah were Reuben the firstborn of Jacob Simeon Levi Judah Issachar and Zebulun
verses.literalPt: Rúben, o primogênito de Jacó, Simeão, Levi, Judá, Issacar e Zebulom, filhos de Lia;

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י רָחֵ֔ל יוֹסֵ֖ף וּבִנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê rā·ḥêl yō·w·sêp̄ ū·ḇin·yā·min
verses.literal: The sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin
verses.literalPt: José e Benjamim, filhos de Raquel;

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֤י בִלְהָה֙ שִׁפְחַ֣ת רָחֵ֔ל דָּ֖ן וְנַפְתָּלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ḇil·hāh šip̄·ḥaṯ rā·ḥêl dān wə·nap̄·tā·lî
verses.literal: The sons of Rachel’s maidservant Bilhah were Dan and Naphtali
verses.literalPt: Dã e Naftali, filhos de Bila, serva de Raquel;

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י זִלְפָּ֛ה שִׁפְחַ֥ת לֵאָ֖ה גָּ֣ד וְאָשֵׁ֑ר אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלַּד־ ל֖וֹ בְּפַדַּ֥ן אֲרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê zil·pāh šip̄·ḥaṯ lê·’āh gāḏ wə·’ā·šêr ’êl·leh bə·nê ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’ă·šer yul·laḏ- lōw bə·p̄ad·dan ’ă·rām
verses.literal: And the sons of Leah’s maidservant Zilpah were Gad and Asher These are the sons of Jacob who were born to him in Paddan-aram
verses.literalPt: e Gade e Aser, filhos de Zilpa, serva de Lia. Estes são os filhos de Jacó que lhe nasceram em Padã-Arã.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל־ יִצְחָ֣ק אָבִ֔יו מַמְרֵ֖א קִרְיַ֣ת הָֽאַרְבַּ֑ע הִ֣וא חֶבְר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר־ גָּֽר־ שָׁ֥ם אַבְרָהָ֖ם וְיִצְחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’el- yiṣ·ḥāq ’ā·ḇîw mam·rê qir·yaṯ hā·’ar·ba‘ hî ḥeḇ·rō·wn ’ă·šer- gār- šām ’aḇ·rā·hām wə·yiṣ·ḥāq
verses.literal: Jacob returned to his father Isaac at Mamre near Kiriath-arba (that is Hebron) where Abraham and Isaac had stayed . . .
verses.literalPt: Veio Jacó a Isaque, seu pai, a Manre, a Quiriate-Arba (esta é Hebrom), onde peregrinaram Abraão e Isaque.

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֖וּ יְמֵ֣י יִצְחָ֑ק מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֖ה וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū yə·mê yiṣ·ḥāq mə·’aṯ šā·nāh ū·šə·mō·nîm šā·nāh
verses.literal: And Isaac lived . . . 180 . . . . . . years
verses.literalPt: Foram os dias de Isaque cento e oitenta anos.

verses.original: וַיִּגְוַ֨ע יִצְחָ֤ק וַיָּ֙מָת֙ וַיֵּאָ֣סֶף אֶל־ עַמָּ֔יו זָקֵ֖ן וּשְׂבַ֣ע יָמִ֑ים וַיִּקְבְּר֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ עֵשָׂ֥ו וְיַעֲקֹ֖ב בָּנָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiḡ·wa‘ yiṣ·ḥāq way·yā·māṯ way·yê·’ā·sep̄ ’el- ‘am·māw zā·qên ū·śə·ḇa‘ yā·mîm way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw ‘ê·śāw wə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ bā·nāw
verses.literal: Then he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his people old and full of years And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him
verses.literalPt: Exalando Isaque o seu espírito, morreu e foi reunido ao seu povo, velho e cheio de dias; e sepultaram-no Esaú e Jacó, seus filhos.
